title: Drift Harbor
summary: A harbor-run experience of gliding currents and buoy avoidance in a stylized port.
instructions: Steer with the cursor. Ride the currents, thread the harbor, and collect every buoy.

overlay.startCopy: A current-driven harbor run. Let the water push you while you weave through the course and sweep the markers.

help.title: How To Start
steps: Press Set Sail in the center overlay.
Steer with the cursor and let the current help you.
Collect every buoy while staying on course.
Use the menu to restart if you drift too far.
tips: Ride the strongest current lines to reduce effort.
The harbor route changes as you collect buoys.

onboarding.title: Harbor Setup
startSteps: Open Help to understand the cursor steering.
Press Set Sail to enter the harbor.
Move toward the nearest buoy while using the current.
onboarding.firstGoal: Collect the first buoy and learn the drift path.
